module: Flowgraph node 'Get Cam Path' (once_f_duration category). Gives information on the state of a camera path (by 'id', otherwise the active one): outputs inactive, complete, completed (impulse once), incomplete and duration. Useful with Simple Cam Path or the procedural path nodes.
notes: The code's description ('Lets the camera follow the path...') is copied from Simple Cam Path; this node only reads the state.
If 'id' is provided but does not match the active path, the node is considered inactive.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets done and completedFlag to zero.

work.desc: On reset, starts again from zero. flow follows the input. With flow, determines whether the path is active, then computes inactive/complete/completed/incomplete/duration via camera:isPathComplete and getPathDuration.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the middle of the node (empty).
